Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the sales and use tax exemption for propane or natural gas used to heat greenhouses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales and use tax exemption for propane ornatural gas used to heat greenhouses; adding a new section to chapter82.08 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales tobusinesses of propane or natural gas used to heat greenhouses. Thepropane or natural gas must be used exclusively to heat greenhouses. (2) The exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller must retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (3) "Greenhouse" means an enclosed structure used for thecultivation or protection of plants.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to theuse by businesses of propane or natural gas to heat greenhouses. (2) The exemption certificate and recordkeeping requirements ofsection 1 of this act apply to this section. (3) "Greenhouse" has the same meaning as provided in section 1 ofthis act.
